blocked_sentences: Awaken 4—{5}{W}{W}{W} (If you cast this spell for {5}{W}{W}{W}, also put four +1/+1 counters on target land you control and it becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land.)

needs.what: an alternative mana cost (702.113a) whose cast line, and only that line, declares an extra required target ("target land you control"), read on resolution by the `evoked`-style condition to put N +1/+1 counters on it and animate it as a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste that is still a land
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `evoke` gives the alternative price and the `evoked` condition, but every evoke line shares the printed target tuples (casting._cast_actions passes the same `tuples` to the evoked _cast_variant), so the land target would either be required on the normal {3}{W}{W} cast too or be `optional` on the awakened cast, where it is mandatory. The only line-specific targets are kicker's `count_if_kicked`/`selector_if_kicked`, and kicker {2}{W} would be an additional cost rather than an alternative one (wrong with free/alternative-cost casts and cost interactions). `cost_option` on a target only reads `additional_cost_options`.
